verdict.rationale: Automations list 'Goals' as one of four core components, which implies conversion tracking per flow. Message performance analysis and reporting are also mentioned, and data-out integrations can push data to external analytics platforms. However, no evidence describes attributing signups or revenue to specific emails or flows beyond these thin mentions. Missing for 10: documented conversion/goal attribution mechanics, revenue attribution per message or flow, attribution window/model details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
